title: DISTINCTCOUNT counts BLANK as one of the distinct values

source.quote: DISTINCTCOUNT function counts the BLANK value.
source.supports: BLANK is one of the values counted

derivation: V[N] holds 5, BLANK, 0, -3, 5, BLANK, 2. Distinct values: 5, BLANK, 0, -3, 2. That is 5 with BLANK, 4 without.
